questions.text: The larger of the two eigenvalues of the matrix [latex]\begin{bmatrix} 4 & 5\\ 2&1 \end{bmatrix}[/latex] is _______.
questions.solution:
[latex]\lambda^2-(4+1)\lambda+(4-10)=\lambda^2-5\lambda-6=(\lambda-6)(\lambda+1)=0[/latex]

Eigenvalues 6 and [latex]-[/latex]1; the larger is 6.

Answer: 6

questions.text:
Consider the following 2x2 matrix A where two elements are unknown and are marked by a and b. The eigenvalues of this matrix are -1 and 7. What are the values of a and b?
[latex]A=\begin{pmatrix} 1 & 4\\ b&a \end{pmatrix}[/latex].
questions.solution:
Checking each statement:
- Trace: 1 + a = [latex]-[/latex]1 + 7 = 6 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] a = 5
- Determinant: a [latex]-[/latex] 4b = ([latex]-[/latex]1)(7) = [latex]-[/latex]7 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] 5 [latex]-[/latex] 4b = [latex]-[/latex]7 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] b = 3

Answer: a = 5, b = 3

Let u = 1/x, so [latex]du=-\frac{dx}{x^2}[/latex]. Limits: x = 1/[latex]\pi[/latex] [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] u = [latex]\pi[/latex], x = 2/[latex]\pi[/latex] [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] u = [latex]\pi/2[/latex].

[latex]\int_{\pi}^{\pi/2}-\cos u\,du=\int_{\pi/2}^{\pi}\cos u\,du=\sin\pi-\sin\frac{\pi}{2}=-1[/latex]

Answer: -1

questions.text: In the LU decomposition of the matrix [latex]\begin{bmatrix} 2 & 2\\ 4&9 \end{bmatrix}[/latex], if the diagonal elements of U are both 1, then the lower diagonal entry [latex]l_{22}[/latex] of L is________.
questions.solution:
Crout form: [latex]\begin{bmatrix}2&2\\4&9\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}l_{11}&0\\l_{21}&l_{22}\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}1&u_{12}\\0&1\end{bmatrix}[/latex]

- [latex]l_{11}=2,\; l_{11}u_{12}=2\Rightarrow u_{12}=1[/latex]
- [latex]l_{21}=4,\; l_{21}u_{12}+l_{22}=9\Rightarrow l_{22}=5[/latex]

Answer: 5
